subject: a rounded chrome block character bouncing on a pad
pose: compressed diagonally at the instant before rebound
art_direction: 圆角金属方块被弹力压成斜菱形，珊瑚底座和内嵌小眼睛赋予倔强弹跳角色感。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create a rounded chrome block character captured at the instant it compresses against a small coral cushion. The block deforms into a slanted diamond while retaining a clearly elastic volume. Two tiny dark inset eyes and a short engraved mouth suggest stubborn cheerfulness, with no human features. Reflect a controlled blue strip along one side of the chrome and warm cream across the top. The cushion flattens beneath the impact but remains compact. Use an empty pale background and a low three-quarter view, keeping the entire bounce shape inside the safe circle of the square. Avoid debris, comic lettering, or motion lines; material compression and tilted posture carry the action.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for distinct original concept, appealing silhouette and expression, requested medium, coherent shape/anatomy, clean visual hierarchy, no text or watermark
